description: For regular k and fewer than k indices, a union has size below k exactly when every constituent set does.
signature:
Cardinal.card_iUnion_lt_iff_forall_of_isRegular.{u} {c : Cardinal.{u}} {ι α : Type u} {t : ι → Set α} (hc : c.IsRegular)
  (hι : Cardinal.mk ι < c) : Cardinal.mk ↑(⋃ i, t i) < c ↔ ∀ (i : ι), Cardinal.mk ↑(t i) < c
